title.narrative: UNESCO-Republic of Korea Funds-In-Trust < Digital Creativity Lab II >

description.narrative:
Based on the achievements of phase I, UNESCO develops a set of best practices on digital creativity catered to different contexts and demands of each Member State at the national level in phase II. Phase II will expand the projects by utilizing the curricula and measures developed in phase 1 for digital policy making and capacity-building programmes in the context of the UNESCO 2005 Convention of the Protection and Promotion of the Diversity of Cultural Expressions under the digital transformation. UNESCO proposes supporting 3 assistance components in partnership with UNESCO field offices:
- Expanding digital horizons by igniting innovation in Thailand Creative Sector, led by UNESCO Bangkok Office - Strengthening civil society towards the copyright law in Indonesia, led by UNESCO Jakarta Office - Digital capacity building of culture and creative sectors in the Republic of Moldova, led by UNESCO Venice Office
